title: DOW-UAP-PR103, Unresolved UAP Report, East China Sea, 2024
what_is_it: A US government video release: 1 minute 16 seconds of infrared sensor footage of an unidentified anomalous phenomenon, with an accompanying official frame-by-frame description.
interpretation_warnings: The object is described only as an 'area of contrast' on an infrared sensor — no shape, size, speed, or identity is established.
The release explicitly states the description is not an analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination of the event's validity or nature.
No PDF body text was extractable; the record relies on metadata and the official video description only.
Single-source military sensor footage; the case is officially 'unresolved', meaning not identified rather than confirmed anomalous.

key_facts.source_quote: video footage from an infrared sensor aboard a U.S. military platform in 2024
